name: besselI
notes: MathTS uses direct series expansion with factorial helper; mathjs uses A&S polynomial approximations with backward recurrence.

name: besselJ
notes: MathTS uses forward recurrence for small orders and Miller's backward recurrence differently; mathjs uses ACC=160 backward recurrence with normalization.

name: besselK
notes: MathTS uses inline k0/k1 helpers with slightly different polynomial coefficients; mathjs uses A&S 9.8 polynomial approximations.

name: besselY
notes: MathTS uses forward recurrence same as mathjs but negative-order sign handling is absent in MathTS.

name: beta
